title: A Clock for the Bridge
author: Yara Iversen
blurb: Freya Iversen, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
